name: perf-stalls
description: App is slow but CPU shows low. Capture IPC, off-CPU clues, cgroup throttle, load average.

commands.description: vmstat — context switches, run queue, blocked, IO wait

commands.command: mpstat -P ALL 1 3 2>/dev/null || echo '(install sysstat for mpstat)'

commands.description: Top cgroups by CPU stat (CFS throttling)

commands.command: cat /proc/pressure/cpu /proc/pressure/io /proc/pressure/memory 2>/dev/null || echo '(PSI not available; kernel < 4.20 or not enabled)'

commands.description: perf stat for 5s on running cgroup (IPC sanity check)
commands.command: sudo perf stat -a sleep 5 2>&1 | tail -20 || echo '(perf needs root or perf_event_paranoid<2)'
